commands.review_summary:
Adds offset-based native chat-history paging, import-aware snapshot handling, and Control UI scroll-back with cursor guards, deduplication, viewport anchoring, and regression coverage.

PR surface: Source +363, Tests +1030. Total +1393 across 14 files.

Reproducibility: yes. A default sessions_history request supplies no offset, the PR's first-page response omits offset, and the consumer immediately discards the otherwise valid pagination metadata.

target.title: feat(chat): native session scroll-back with offset paging and import-aware history
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Native OpenClaw sessions had no scroll-back: `chat.history` returned a single recent tail window and the Control UI offered no way to reach older messages. Catalog (Claude Code / Codex) sessions already got automatic scroll-back in #105209; native sessions — the far more common case — did not.

Closes #105127.

## Why This Change Was Made

Unify the older-history experience across native and catalog sessions using the same UI machinery (IntersectionObserver top sentinel, spinner row, viewport anchoring, bounded cursor guards) landed in #105209, backed by a new offset paging contract on `chat.history`.

Server:
- `chat.history` accepts `offset` and returns `{hasMore, nextOffset, totalMessages}` (`ChatHistoryPagination`); offset pages read strictly-older transcript slices without re-materializing the whole session.
- Cursor advance is strict: when replaying the oldest partially-budgeted record cannot advance the cursor, the record is skipped past (omission reported via existing diagnostics) instead of returning a non-advancing cursor the UI would read as exhaustion.
- CLI-bound sessions (claude-cli imports) keep their terminal snapshot contract: one full local read per snapshot load, stable imported message IDs, and `completeSnapshot` withheld when byte caps truncate the response (honest signal for the deferred opaque-snapshot-cursor follow-up, #105644).
- Fixed an infinite recursion when the recent tail window incorporates CLI imports but the full local read dedupes them all: `ignoreCliSessionImports` now gates the import resolver itself, so the re-entry terminates in local-only paging.

UI:
- Native sessions reuse the catalog scroll-back path: shared top sentinel + spinner + anchor-preserving prepend, with `olderOffsetsSeen` guarding against cursor loops and message identity dedupe on prepend.

## User Impact

Scrolling up in any native session now automatically loads older messages with a loading indicator, without reloading the session. Bound Claude CLI sessions no longer risk a gateway-pegging infinite loop on a realistic dedupe layout.

## Evidence

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/gateway/server.chat.gateway-server-chat-b.test.ts ui/src/pages/chat/chat-pane.test.ts ui/src/e2e/claude-sessions.e2e.test.ts` — green (126 + 27 + 2 tests).
- Negative proof for the recursion fix: with the resolver gate reverted, the new regression test (`chat.history terminates when the full local read dedupes every claude-cli import`) spins the gateway at ~100% CPU indefinitely; with the fix it passes.
- Strict-cursor regression tests prove `nextOffset > offset` for pathological multi-sibling records and eventual access to the oldest record.
- Linux Testbox: gateway + chat-pane suites green; claude-sessions E2E green on retry after one cold-setup timeout (exact unchanged rerun 2/2).
- Autoreview: the earlier recursion finding is fixed with negative proof; the two remaining findings are consciously rejected as the scoped #105644 tradeoff: (a) byte-truncated imported snapshots stay terminal — on `main` bound sessions already return one merged tail with `hasMore: false`, so this branch strictly widens reachable history and adds the honest withheld-`completeSnapshot` signal; (b) one full local-transcript read per snapshot load mirrors the complete external JSONL scan the import reader already performs on `main` (same O(N) class, once per load, not per page — the per-page O(N²) variant was reverted). Both get the proper fix via the opaque snapshot cursor in #105644.
